name: PowerShell Disk Report (Cronsole)
description: Print free space for every fixed drive on the Cronsole host, so the numbers land in the run history and you can read them back over time.

action.body:
# Needs PowerShell on the machine running the Cronsole backend.
# That is your desktop for a normal install, and the CONTAINER on a
# Dockerized stack — where these drives are the container’s, not yours.

Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DriveType=3" |
  ForEach-Object {
    $freeGb  = [math]::Round($_.FreeSpace / 1GB, 1)
    $totalGb = [math]::Round($_.Size / 1GB, 1)
    "{0} {1} GB free of {2} GB" -f $_.DeviceID, $freeGb, $totalGb
  }
